text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Wooow! Look, Trainer! Tatami mats!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And hanging wall scrolls!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It feels just like a traditional Japanese hot spring inn! How splendid!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, Fine Motion and I have arrived for the hot spring vacation we won in the raffle.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …I think it's actually best if I give this to you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At the time, Fine Motion wasn't sure if she'd even be able to come on this trip.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, once it was decided that she'd be staying in Japan, I gave it back to her.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You'll come with me, of course, right? Then, let's decide when we'll go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …And so, here we are at the hot springs, with Fine Motion's security team in tow.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Let's jump into the hot spring right away! With a real big splash!
choice_data_list: You're supposed to be quiet in the hot spring, okay?
You're supposed to be quiet in the hot spring, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Okay, okay. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The water was exquisite! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Did I! I'm soft, glossy, and smooth, from the top of my head to the tip of my tail and down to my very soul! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I wonder if they could build a hot spring in the family's castle?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'd open it up to the public so that everyone in Ireland could enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Captain…

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: I'll be sure to make your desires known… On that note, we'll be taking our leave now.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: Under orders from Her Highness, we'll be lodging elsewhere. We'll only be a stone's throw away, of course.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It's not every day we go to a hot spring like this, so I want everyone to recharge their batteries without feeling on edge.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And besides, I have Trainer with me. We'll be okay, right, Trainer? ♪

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: …Very well. Please contact us immediately if there's any trouble, no matter how trivial.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Understood!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …They're all so passionate about their work.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: They refused to leave my side, so before I knew it, I ended up ordering them. I want them to enjoy themselves, after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I think Fine Motion's security team is likely happiest when they're at her side, but I opt to bite my tongue.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Now then, why don't we go for a short stroll before dinner?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hm, hm, hmmm. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's something bothering me. Just before, Fine Motion said she wanted her security team to recharge their batteries…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Why are you staring at me so intently? Has my glossy skin caught your eye?
choice_data_list: Are you recharging your batteries right now?
Are you recharging your batteries right now?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh? Perhaps, you can't see it, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Come, look really closely! Can't you see the green charging indicator on my back?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: See it flashing? Blip, blip! I'm sure those with a truly discerning eye can spot it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Excellent! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You know, I really like spending time with you. I like how I am when we're together.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Of course, I also love being with my friends. I even love myself, royal heritage and all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: But when I'm with you… I'm a bit more selfish, a bit more stubborn, and quite ridiculous.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: But you know, you could argue a little at least! Especially about the being ridiculous part!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ehe. Well, I do have to live up to being called "Her Highness." ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: … Phew…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: So that's why from now on…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Let me be your Fine Motion. Forever and ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I sense that Fine Motion and I have formed an irreplaceable bond during this time together.
